statements.impact_statement: realm-cli reaches @hono/node-server only via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's StreamableHTTPServerTransport (which uses @hono/node-server's getRequestListener) for the 'realm serve' command's JSON-RPC HTTP transport; the vulnerable serve-static handler is never imported or registered anywhere in that transport or in realm's own source, so the vulnerable path is not reachable. The advisory is additionally Windows-only, while realm deploys to macOS/Linux. @sensigo/realm-mcp declares the same @modelcontextprotocol/sdk version but uses only its stdio transport (StdioServerTransport), never loading the HTTP transport module that references @hono/node-server at all.
